# Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | Why |
|------|---------|-----|
| [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) | 4.3+ | Runs the analysis pipeline |
| [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) | 1.4+ | Renders the guide and the manuscript |
| [Git](https://git-scm.com/) | any | Version control, cloning the template |
| A LaTeX distribution | any | Only if you render the manuscript to PDF (e.g. `quarto install tool tinytex`) |

## Restore the R library

This template pins package versions with **renv**. After cloning:

```r
install.packages("renv")
renv::restore()
```

`renv::restore()` recreates the project library exactly as recorded in `renv.lock`. Later, when you add packages, run `renv::snapshot()` to update the lockfile.

## Verify Quarto

```bash
quarto check
quarto render paper/paper.qmd --to html
```

If the manuscript renders to HTML, you are ready.

## Package overview

The pipeline draws on a small, well-maintained set of packages:

| Package | Used by |
|---------|---------|
| `survey`, `srvyr` | survey design, weighted estimates |
| `WeightIt`, `cobalt` | IPTW construction, balance diagnostics |
| `sandwich`, `lmtest` | robust / cluster-robust SEs for effects |
| `poLCA` | latent class analysis |
| `igraph`, `ggraph` | network construction & visualization |
| `gt`, `modelsummary` | reporting tables |
| `targets` *(optional)* | pipeline orchestration |

All of these are captured in `renv.lock`.
